protocol.version: v1.0 (lock candidate; LOCKED only when the lock RDR is recorded)

data.signal: MAT eeg_data rows 1-19 (Fp1..Pz stored order), 500 Hz

qc.primary_eligibility: no bad scalp channel and satisfactory C3/C4; no interpolation (06 issue 12)

exclusions: first and last full 4-s epoch of each recording (all representations)
IED epochs without a reconstructable marker
non-IED epochs adjacent to an IED epoch (negatives)

evaluability.rule: in at least one common wake/sleep state, after all exclusions (R3)

window.name: label-blind salience-selected 2-s window
window.salience: per channel smoothed Teager-Kaiser energy (20-ms smoothing) on CAR, z-scored by recording-wide median and MAD; max over 19 channels
window.t_raw: argmax salience over the full epoch [0, 4) s

learners.selection_metric: mean within-patient same-state AUROC over evaluable patients in the inner validation folds, equal weight; ties -> simpler configuration

training_weights: 1/n_p per patient epoch; negatives x pi+_s/pi-_s (patient-weighted state shares) per training set; identical across paired models (R9)

estimand.name: procedure-level within-patient same-state DeltaAUROC (B2+FC minus B2), equal patient weight
estimand.per_repeat: Mann-Whitney AUROC per evaluable state, combined by IED-count weights; Delta_p = mean over repeats; never pool scores across repeats

positive_controls.PC-1: FC-only model; 95% lower bound (primary method) of within-patient AUROC > 0.5; gate
positive_controls.PC-3: synthetic: lag recovery, surrogate destruction, real vs surrogate null-coupling wPLI match; gate
positive_controls.PC-2: biological sanity check; not a gate

pre_confirmatory_validation.EV-1: synthetic CI-coverage check with HGB and nested tuning before unblinding; inadequate NB coverage -> stop, RDR
